acceptanceCriteria: Each finding derives only from the recognised host event format.
Findings cite the evidence file and line range.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1047 (opened 2026-10-17). Feature request; not yet specified. Problem Sessions can end uselessly in ways the queue cannot see: a model request retried repeatedly with no completion, repeated provider errors, or a first tool call refused (wrong worktree or attempt id) so no work happens. Current workaround A script scans each worker's stdout for 3 or more step starts without a finish, 3 or more provider errors in an hour, and refusals before any work. Proposal Using the existing host usage-format parsers, add findings HOST_RETRY_STORM, HOST_ERRORS and EARLY_REFUSAL with counts and the worker id. See beamfall/corvint#1047 for the full text.
title: doctor: session-outcome findings from host event output (issue #1047)
